marketing_description: The Maytag Professional Series MVWP586GW electric top load washer features a stainless steel drum and offers 4 cycles and 3 temperature settings. This model has a capacity of 16 lb and operates at 120 V, 15 A, and 1300 W. The MVWP586GW also includes features such as mechanical knob control, automatic balancing, and an end-of-cycle signal.
